title: IOL Chemicals & Pharmaceuticals Ltd - 524164 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: Q4 FY26 revenue hit a record INR619 crore (+17.4% YoY) and EBITDA margin rose 251 bps to 15.2%, helped by Ibuprofen demand recovery and higher prices.
summary.overview: Q4 FY26 revenue from operations was INR619 crore versus INR528 crore a year earlier, the company's highest-ever quarterly revenue. EBITDA rose about 40% to INR94 crore, with margin up 251 bps to 15.2%, and PAT rose 68% to about INR53 crore. For FY26, revenue grew 11.5% to INR2,319 crore, EBITDA grew about 29% to INR290 crore (margin 12.4% vs 10.7%), and PAT rose about 36% to INR138 crore. Management attributed the gains to utilisation, product mix, non-Ibuprofen traction and a late-quarter price uptick that was partly offset by raw material cost increases.

financial_highlights.change: +~40% YoY vs INR68 crore; margin +251 bps
+68% YoY vs INR32 crore; margin +262 bps

financial_highlights.value: ~INR160 crore, funded fully from internal accruals

segments.name: Pharmaceuticals (Ibuprofen and non-Ibuprofen API)
segments.commentary: Ibuprofen contributed about 62% and non-Ibuprofen about 38% of pharma revenue in Q4. Non-Ibu exports are about 20% of non-Ibu sales; Ibuprofen exports are about 45-50%. Management does not split margins between Ibu and non-Ibu.

segments.name: Chemicals (acetic anhydride, ethyl acetate, Triacetin)
segments.commentary: Acetic anhydride and ethyl acetate run at 98-100% utilisation after capacity increases; ethyl acetate capacity went from 110,000 to 120,000 tonnes. Acetic anhydride is about 50-60% captively consumed; ethyl acetate is fully sold merchant. Triacetin was recently commissioned.

guidance_outlook: FY27: revenue growth of about 15% (management range mid-to-high teens; 'more or less 1-2%'), and EBITDA margin of about 14% to 14.5%.
FY27 target revenue about INR2,700 crore; company expects around 15% annual top-line growth on existing capacity.
Management said the company is maintaining its earlier FY27 guidance of 10-15% revenue growth and 15-20% PAT growth, and that it may improve slightly.
Quarter-to-quarter margins are not guided; management prefers full-year commentary. The price uptick is expected to hold for one or two quarters.

Greenfield land (100 acres, near Bhatinda Highway): capex of INR200-250 crore a year funded by internal accruals, total outlay about INR1,200-1,400 crore over four to five years; project to start in four to six (or six to eight) quarters, subject to pending approvals.
Paracetamol utilisation on the new 10,800 MT plant expected to reach 70-75% in FY27 and full capacity in FY28.
capex_capacity: Greenfield 100-acre site: environmental clearance in place, other approvals partly secured, capex not yet initiated; management expects most approvals within three to four months.
Capex split roughly 60% growth and 40% infrastructure, automation and land; the FY27 plan is about INR200 crore.
Paracetamol capacity expanded from 3,600 MT to 10,800 MT; the new plant runs at about 55% utilisation.
Existing products (Ibu, Metformin, Clopidogrel, Fenofibrate) run at 85-95% utilisation, averaging about 90%. Ethyl acetate capacity is 120,000 tonnes.
Pantoprazole capacity was expanded; Minoxidil launched. Maximum revenue from existing capacity at 100% utilisation is estimated at INR3,200-3,300 crore.
demand_pricing: Ibuprofen demand recovered from October 2025 after destocking in 2023-24 and new competitor entry; management expects this level to hold for four to six quarters. Ibuprofen demand is estimated to grow 3-4% a year.

Price increases came in the later part of Q4 and were driven by higher crude-linked raw material and logistics costs; management said the spread is broadly unchanged because raw material costs were passed through.
Ethyl acetate spreads are better in April and May than in the March quarter, per management's confirmation.
Management said a Q4 inventory gain was not meaningful, as the price uptick came late in the quarter.
Management sees no supply problems on raw materials except for about one week in early March when crude-based chemicals and gas supply were disrupted.
Non-Ibu customers are mainly direct consumers rather than traders, which limits the upside from price moves.

qa_highlights.question: Greenfield land: timeline and capex quantum?
qa_highlights.answer: Project expected in four to six (or six to eight) quarters; capex of INR200-250 crore a year, total about INR1,200-1,400 crore over four to five years, funded from internal accruals.

qa_highlights.question: Is the Q4 gross margin sustainable, or was it an inventory gain?
qa_highlights.answer: Management attributed it to efficiency, product mix and capacity utilisation, plus a late-quarter price rise; it said there was no meaningful inventory gain and that quarter-to-quarter prediction is risky.

qa_highlights.question: Is FY27 guidance being maintained or upgraded?
qa_highlights.answer: Maintained: about 15% revenue growth (mid-to-high teens), and EBITDA margin of about 14-14.5%.

qa_highlights.question: Is the Ibuprofen margin under pressure, given a peer's stated plan to shut down?
qa_highlights.answer: No. Management said Ibu is one of its best products, with 90-95% utilisation, and sees no issues for the next two to three quarters.

qa_highlights.question: How much R&D spend, and what products are in the launch pipeline?
qa_highlights.answer: R&D is about 2-3% of revenue annually and is mainly process-related. Management did not name specific upcoming launches, saying products are announced when a decision is taken.

qa_highlights.question: Paracetamol utilisation and margin impact of the 3x capacity expansion?
qa_highlights.answer: The new 10,800 MT plant is at about 55% utilisation, targeted at 70-75% in FY27 and full in FY28; higher utilisation is expected to lower unit cost.

qa_highlights.question: US FDA status?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said two US FDA inspections have been done, all products have CEPs, and approvals for Brazil and others are in place; ANDA approvals are granted without a site visit.

qa_highlights.question: Employee cost trend and guidance?
qa_highlights.answer: Rise driven by variable pay provision and new plant headcount; employee cost guided at about 9-10% of revenue.

risks_watch: Price-driven margin uplift may not persist; management expects it for one or two quarters only, and raw material inflation (crude-linked, logistics) could offset it.
Ibuprofen demand recovery depends on destocking holding and on new competitor entry; a peer's stated closure and possible asset sales could change the competitive picture.
Greenfield project (INR1,200-1,400 crore) depends on pending regulatory approvals, and management gave conflicting timelines (four to six vs six to eight quarters).
Paracetamol new-plant ramp (55% to 70-75%) needs to be delivered in FY27.
Heavy reliance on China-sourced starting materials (e.g. for Metformin) and on crude-linked supply.
Management declined to comment on product-level margins, Ibu vs non-Ibu split, or a potential acquisition of an Ibuprofen asset.
summary.management_tone: Confident on FY26 execution and FY27 targets, but cautious on near-term quarters, repeatedly steering analysts to full-year figures. Evasive on product-level margins, the Ibuprofen asset sale and the buyback. Some call-handling issues occurred, and a few answers were incomplete.
key_quotes: FY26 has been a good year for the company, marked by consistent operational execution, improving efficiencies and healthy progress across both pharmaceuticals and chemical businesses.

Q4 FY26 was particularly encouraging for us as the company reported its highest-ever quarterly revenue, supported by cost optimisation, improving product mix and enhanced capacity utilisation across key product lines.
So basically, you need to know the quarter-to-quarter basis. However, we have more interest on discussing the full -year basis.
The capex we are doing, we will be doing through internal accruals.

growth.why: Management reiterated FY27 revenue growth of about 15% (range 10-15%, possibly 1-2 points either way) and EBITDA margin of 14-14.5%, backed by existing capacity at ~90% utilisation, the Paracetamol plant ramp (70-75% utilisation targeted in FY27) and an ibuprofen demand recovery, with greenfield capex of INR200-250 crore a year still awaiting approvals.
